# Kuailu was awarded the "AI Innovation Applications Award" for the 6th International Science Founding Festival, and its capacity was re-recognized!

- Publication channel: China Daily News Network (central media)
- Published: 2026-04-07
- Original link: [https://caijing.chinadaily.com.cn/a/202604/07/WS69d4ca0ea310942cc49a6a8a.html](https://caijing.chinadaily.com.cn/a/202604/07/WS69d4ca0ea310942cc49a6a8a.html]

## Text
With the deepening of AI+ outreach, accelerating the landing of AI applications and deepening the coverage of AI scenarios has become the dominant trend. The Kuailu Smart Office acts as the ASI First Site, building the AI Office, the AI Collaboration, and the full-scope AI Conference Ecology using the AAI Base because of the engine. Recently, the SITIF Sixth International Science Festival Award was announced, and Kuailu's Smart Office was awarded a list of the best companies in the country's AI field, with advanced models, in order to get a unified data base, full-scene Ai coverage of the quality and be awarded the Innovation Applications Award!

STIF International Science and Technology Festival: One of the most influential annual events in the field of science, technology, innovation and new quality of productivity, aimed at bringing about innovation through a comprehensive demonstration of the achievements of science, technology and innovation through the building of a pluralistic and open platform of communication and cooperation. Each year, more than 300 global leading brands of science and technology and new quality productivity gather together, affecting and interacting with more than 20 million people, and their awards are seen as important yardsticks for measuring the capabilities of enterprises in science, technology and innovation.

AI+ empowers and results are authoritatively recognized

The award is a recognition of Kuailu ' s deep-farming track and the ongoing AI-enabled industry ' s intellectualization process. In the digital wave, Kuailu's smart office-in-house systems were built with “multi-system, decentralized and fragmented” problems, starting with the “uniform digital base, a system that covers the business landscape” and emerging from a crowd of software enterprises, making the flow of unhindered internal data a valuable asset for businesses, and now working together with nearly 200 business, manufacturing and education pioneers.

The flow of data is the cornerstone of the AIization of enterprises. In 2025, Kuailu ' s intelligent office products were in full line, drawing on the power of AI+ to allow enterprises to leave the traditional system "heavy". In the case of ProAvanti, a global high-end medical equipment provider, the smart leap of multiple core scenarios was achieved through the unified empowerment of KuailuAI.

Equipment AI forecast maintenance: Based on equipment maintenance records accumulated over the years by ProAvanti, spare parts consumption data, terminal customer equipment operation work, construction of AI model, early warning equipment failure and loss of vulnerable items, proposal to automatically generate spare parts procurement, passive maintenance as a proactive prevention, projected reduction of 30 per cent of unplanned downtime.

Inventory smart warning and automatic replenishment: AI, combined with sales forecasts, maintenance worksheet trends and procurement cycles, dynamic calculation of safe stock thresholds, automatically triggers a procurement request when inventory is below the warning line and avoids delivery delays due to missing items.

Sales funnel AI analysis: AI Autoanalysing Businesses to follow up on the recording of interactions with customers, predicts single probability and gives "best action next" recommendations to help local sales teams focus on high-value leads, and is expected to further increase conversion rates by over 20 per cent.

Global intelligence, assistive enterprise level AI down Land

AI is moving from "intelligent perception" to "intellectual decision-making + auto-execution." Scene validation is integrated with the depth of the workflow, which is key to releasing AI values. Based on this, Kuailu ' s Smart Office has been re-engineered to upgrade its product line in depth, integrating AI capture, analytical capabilities into the core dimensions of client insight, quotations, slotting, market operations, etc., in order to make AI truly accessible and productive:

- • AIS diagnostics: daily automatic analysis of clues, customer, business data, generation of diagnostic recommendations, one minute of manual recalculation.
- • AI Client Insight: Enter the name of the client, automatically capture business information, distribution patterns, competitors, trade pain points, etc., and generate three first-time communication topics from different angles.
- • AI Generates quotations: generate downloadable, printable quotations based on the first key of commercial information to support automatic calculation of discounts.
- AI Operational Plan: Based on CRM data, generate a daily follow-up plan for each sale.

Using Kuailu as an example of an “AI field expert” under the smart office flag, as the leading enterprise-level intelligent body in the industry, the depths of which meet the four immediate needs of users for security deployment, skills governance, compliance and auditing, and user privileges, through the “Skill injection, data penetration, knowledge retention” three-step approach, allow clients to use multi-system data in natural languages to complete the closed loop from demand to implementation, subject to the security conditions of privatization deployment. There is no need to change any work habits to make AI a “digital employee” of the enterprise, efficient and effective!

The Kuailu smart office will continue to focus on leading technologies, data access, and landscapes, aligning with the needs of the exclusive industry, accelerating the size of the AI scene, helping more firms to take a step forward and embrace the smart dividend!
